item.title: Important Notice: DOI Activation Issue
item.description: Dear Authors, We would like to inform you that due to a recent system update, we are experiencing an issue with DOI activation. Please rest assured that our team is actively working to resolve this problem as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologise for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding during this time. If you have any urgent concerns or questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to our support team at rpcvj@clujveterinaryjournal.ro. Thank yo

item.title: DOAJ Indexing
item.description: Starting with 3 August 2022 the Cluj Veterinary Journal is accepted and indexed in DOAJ database. We are pround to mark another milestone for Cluj Veterinary Journal

item.title: Submission
item.description: Cluj Veterinary Journal accepts articles for publication in the upcoming issue. Feel free to send your article via the website submission system. For more information, contact the journal editorial team at office@clujveterinaryjournal.ro or rpcvj@clujveterinaryjournal.ro.
